A polymath’s garden

Good design starts
with being curious.

Inspired by the Orto Botanico di Padova, I think of design as a garden — a place where science, care, and experimentation grow together.

Everything is connected.

First, the questions.

How do people think, act, and feel around technology? I started in electronics, making sense of systems. Then came college posters, digital audits, and a growing fascination with the people on the other side of the screen.

Electronics → a different kind of connection

Then, a change of perspective.

Interaction Design at the National Institute of Design, Bengaluru, helped me bring systems and empathy into the same conversation. Research, making, failing, unlearning. And trying again.

NID Bengaluru · Interaction Design

Now, connecting worlds.

From helping Grandma shop online to designing human–AI collaboration, I find joy in making unfamiliar things feel familiar. Today, I’m building consumer and enterprise products at Blinkit.

People + systems + a little possibility
